disclaimer: Evidence ledger only; not a runtime authorization system or independent security certification.

open-synthetic-testnet.description: Allow volunteers to run synthetic-only peers; no real sensing or untrusted measured data accepted.

gates.reason: Current operator service is Docker harness; no independently deployed, provisioned host run.
Public connection, message and stream resource policies are not validated.
Internet-facing hostile peers, flood tests and disconnect recovery not tested.
No documented/revocable public node enrollment and safe opt-out protocol.
No 24/7 ownership, monitoring, emergency shutdown, backup or abuse-response procedure.
No tagged artifact integrity, reproducible release or vulnerability response drill.

public-real-sensing.description: Real BLE-derived regional observations may be shared beyond a controlled, consented pilot.

gates.reason: No independently held-out multi-site field calibration evidence.
No independent privacy review covering stable signer metadata, sparse observations and inference.
No real-data opt-in UX, versioned consent receipt or withdrawal tests.
Replicated signed archives cannot currently be remotely retracted with guaranteed semantics.
Valid signatures do not prove unique sensor, independent operator or physical location.
No site permissions and jurisdiction-specific privacy/legal review.
No independently reviewed sparse-cell suppression/coverage confidence release policy.
